QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Fish Out of Water
QuestInfo.0: You heard Leon and Gilberto talking in serious voices on the first floor. You asked Leon to fill you in.
QuestInfo.1: You heard Leon and Gilberto talking in serious voices on the first floor. They told you of a troubling matter.
QuestInfo.2: You awoke to the sounds of a serious discussion. It seems the Delfinos living in the canals of Commerci are causing trouble. Gilberto says this is a problem they need to solve, but thought you should listen to the details.
